# Angola OpenSourceRail Campaign
<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-marketing-campaigns.py. -->

National outreach package covering **9 catalogued cities**. Values
below aggregate city screening models; the national brief separately treats the
shared manufacturing plant.

## Audience

- Angola ministry responsible for transport and urban mobility
- Angola national climate, energy or Green Climate Fund authority
- Angola public investment, planning or finance authority
- Embassy or High Commission of Angola in the United Kingdom — economic section

## National proposition

| Measure | Catalogue result |
|---|---:|
| Population represented | 13,135,000 |
| Lines / route length | 30 / 682 km |
| Fleet | 1,254 trainsets |
| City programme CAPEX | $6.45 B |
| Local capital and value allocation | $4.78 B (74%) |
| Station/depot PV / storage | 111.9 MW / 638.0 MWh |
| Illustrative external-capital saving | $9.94 B |

Lead with a government-reviewed pilot, local manufacturing and construction,
open standards, renewable-energy integration and independently checked demand,
environmental, social and engineering studies.
